title: D Dodge the Car
statementMd:
Dodge the Car
     Input file:            standard input
     Output file:           standard output
     Time limit:            2 seconds
     Memory limit:          512 megabytes

You are about to cross the road, but a car is speeding along it.
In the Cartesian plane, a road of width w extends infinitely in the x-direction and occupies the strip
0 ≤ y ≤ w. You want to cross it from the lower boundary y = 0 to the upper boundary y = w, while
avoiding a car on the road.
The car’s body is represented by a simple polygon with n vertices. At time t = 0, its vertices are
(x1 , y1 ), (x2 , y2 ), . . . , (xn , yn ) in counterclockwise boundary order. The car moves with constant horizontal
velocity u, so at time t its i-th vertex is at (xi + ut, yi ).
You may move in any direction or wait, but your speed must never exceed v. Equivalently, for any two
times 0 ≤ t1 ≤ t2 , the Euclidean distance between your positions at those times must be at most v(t2 −t1 ).
At no time may you be strictly inside the car’s body; touching its boundary is allowed.
You are given q independent queries. In the j-th query, you start from (sj , 0) at time t = 0. Find the
minimum time needed to reach any point on y = w safely. For every query, the car starts again from the
same given configuration at t = 0; the queries do not affect one another. It can be shown that an answer
always exists.

Input
The first line contains an integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 5 × 104 ), the number of test cases.
Each test case begins with a line containing four integers n, w, u, v (3 ≤ n ≤ 5 × 105 , 1 ≤ w, v ≤ 109 ,
−109 ≤ u ≤ 109 ): the number of vertices of the car, the width of the road, the car’s horizontal velocity,
and your maximum speed, respectively.
The next n lines describe the car at time t = 0. The i-th line contains two integers xi , yi (−109 ≤ xi ≤ 109 ,
0 ≤ yi ≤ w), the coordinates of its i-th vertex. The vertices are given in counterclockwise boundary order
and form a simple polygon: non-adjacent edges have no common point, adjacent edges intersect only at
their common endpoint, and no three consecutive vertices are collinear.
The next line contains an integer q (1 ≤ q ≤ 5 × 105 ), the number of queries. Each of the following q lines
contains an integer sj (−109 ≤ sj ≤ 109 ), specifying the starting point (sj , 0) for the j-th query.
It is guaranteed that both the sum of n and the sum of q over all test cases do not exceed 5 × 105 .

Output
For each query, output one real number on a separate line: the minimum time needed to reach y = w
safely.
Your answer is considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed 10−6 . More precisely,
                                                                                           |a−b|
for each value a you output and the corresponding reference value b, the requirement is max(1,|b|) ≤ 10−6 .

statementZhMd:
躲避汽车
     输入文件：            标准输入
     输出文件：            标准输出
     时间限制：            2 秒
     内存限制：            512 MB

你正准备过马路，但一辆汽车正在路上疾驰。

在笛卡尔平面中，一条宽度为 w 的道路沿 x 方向无限延伸，占据区域 0 ≤ y ≤ w。你希望从道路的下边界 y = 0 穿行到上边界 y = w，同时避开道路上的汽车。

汽车的车身用一个有 n 个顶点的简单多边形表示。在 t = 0 时，其顶点按边界逆时针顺序依次为 (x1, y1), (x2, y2), . . . , (xn, yn)。汽车以恒定的水平速度 u 行驶，因此在时刻 t，其第 i 个顶点位于 (xi + ut, yi)。

你可以向任意方向移动，也可以等待，但你的速度始终不能超过 v。等价地，对于任意两个时刻 0 ≤ t1 ≤ t2，你在这两个时刻所处位置之间的欧几里得距离至多为 v(t2 − t1)。在任何时刻，你都不能严格位于汽车车身内部；允许接触车身边界。

给定 q 个相互独立的询问。在第 j 个询问中，你在 t = 0 时从 (sj, 0) 出发。求安全到达 y = w 上任意一点所需的最短时间。对于每个询问，汽车都会在 t = 0 时从给定的同一初始状态重新开始运动；各个询问互不影响。可以证明，答案总是存在。

输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 T (1 ≤ T ≤ 5 × 10⁴)，表示测试用例的数量。

每个测试用例的第一行包含四个整数 n, w, u, v (3 ≤ n ≤ 5 × 10⁵, 1 ≤ w, v ≤ 10⁹, −10⁹ ≤ u ≤ 10⁹)，分别表示汽车的顶点数、道路的宽度、汽车的水平速度以及你的最大速度。

接下来 n 行描述汽车在 t = 0 时的状态。第 i 行包含两个整数 xi, yi (−10⁹ ≤ xi ≤ 10⁹, 0 ≤ yi ≤ w)，表示其第 i 个顶点的坐标。顶点按边界逆时针顺序给出，并构成一个简单多边形：不相邻的边没有公共点，相邻的边仅在公共端点处相交，且任意三个连续顶点不共线。

接下来一行包含一个整数 q (1 ≤ q ≤ 5 × 10⁵)，表示询问的数量。随后 q 行中的每一行包含一个整数 sj (−10⁹ ≤ sj ≤ 10⁹)，表示第 j 个询问的起点为 (sj, 0)。

保证所有测试用例的 n 之和与 q 之和均不超过 5 × 10⁵。

输出格式

对于每个询问，在单独一行输出一个实数，表示安全到达 y = w 所需的最短时间。

如果你的答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 10⁻⁶，则视为正确。更准确地说，对于你输出的每个值 a 及其对应的参考值 b，要求 |a−b| / max(1,|b|) ≤ 10⁻⁶。
